2609.02203.title: SMart: A Multi-source Multi-phase Time Series Representation Transfer Framework
2609.02203.paper_summary: Time series representation learning (TSRL) has attracted growing research interests in recent years. Two recent explorations in TSRL are: i) exploiting a transformer-based framework to learn time series; ii) instead of using only the targeted dataset, borrowing time series from other datasets to to facilitate representation transfer. While these two explorations are shown effective, the self-supervised time series recovery task in (i) and the single-source dataset used in (ii) are technically simple and thus can be enhanced with new ideas. In this work, we propose a new TSRL framework, namely multi-source multi-phase time series representation transfer (SMart), which has two novel mechanisms to address the aforementioned deficiencies: 1) a multi-phase recurrence plots recovery task, in three alternative modes, for guiding the encoder to embed time series dynamics into the time series representation; and 2) a source dataset selector to select multiple suitable source datasets to supplement the original target dataset for pre-training the TSRL encoder. Experimental results show that SMart outperforms several state-of-the-art models for time series representation learning, classification and regression on both uni-variate and multi-variate time series datasets, reducing mean absolute error up to 19.5% for time series regression, and increasing average accuracy up to 1.34\% for time series classification.
2609.02203.paper_summary_zh: 時間序列表示學習（TSRL）在近年來引起了越來越多的研究興趣。最近在TSRL中的兩個探索是：i) 利用基於Transformer的框架來學習時間序列；ii) 不僅使用目標數據集，而是借用其他數據集的時間序列來促進表示轉移。雖然這兩個探索被證明是有效的，但（i）中的自我監督時間序列恢復任務和（ii）中使用的單一來源數據集在技術上是簡單的，因此可以通過新想法進行增強。在這項工作中，我們提出了一個新的TSRL框架，即多來源多階段時間序列表示轉移（SMart），它有兩個新機制來解決上述缺陷：1) 一個多階段回歸圖恢復任務，以三種替代模式引導編碼器將時間序列動態嵌入時間序列表示中；2) 一個來源數據集選擇器，用於選擇多個合適的來源數據集，以補充原始目標數據集，用於預訓練TSRL編碼器。實驗結果顯示，SMart在時間序列表示學習、分類和回歸方面超越了幾個最先進的模型，對於單變量和多變量時間序列數據集，將時間序列回歸的平均絕對誤差降低了高達19.5%，並將時間序列分類的平均準確率提高了高達1.34%。
2609.02203.author: Fang He et.al.
